newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Bahrain stocks stable in the week.
newsitem.headline: Bahrain stocks stable in the week.

text.p: Bahrain stocks were little changed in the week to Thursday, with the index closing at 1,539.10 points from 1,539.91 a week earlier, the Bahrain Stock Exchange said.
Trade volume fell to eight million shares from 13.4 million shares a week earlier but the value of stocks traded rose to 2.57 dinars ($6.8 million) from 2.23 million dinars.
Shares of 22 firms of the 39 registered at the exchange were traded, down from 26 a week ago, with banking and investment sectors dominating dealings.
International investment group Investcorp was the most active, with shares worth 958,000 dinars changing hands -- around 37 percent of overall trade.
Al-Ahli Commercial Bank followed with script worth 300,000 dinars dealt.
Bahrain's market is open to nationals in Gulf Arab states -- Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, Qatar, Oman, Bahrain and the United Arab Emirates. Certain firms are also open to foreign investors.
